titolo: Claude Code plugin 'lot-map' adds live visual map of tool calls and model steps
descr: New open‑source plugin shows Claude Code activity in a side pane, visualising tool calls, file actions and network requests locally.
paragrafi: A GitHub project called lot‑map provides a live map that appears beside Claude Code chats.
The pane lights up each tool call, model step, hook, skill and sub‑agent as they occur, turning red on errors.
Installation works via the Claude plugin command line or the desktop app, requiring at least 144 terminal columns for full view.
The plugin runs entirely on the user’s machine and does not transmit data elsewhere.
It was built and tested on Claude Code version 2.1.321 on macOS, with reports of Windows compatibility.
perche: The visual feedback helps developers track Claude Code actions without reading logs, improving debugging and transparency. Because the plugin is local‑only, it aligns with users seeking free, privacy‑preserving AI tooling.
